title: Delivery Failure Reduction on Return Shipping Fees
content:
Where delivery of the order went wrong, the Returns & Exchanges return shipping fee is reduced. The reduction follows the Delivery Claims case on the return's order: its claim type and status.

| Delivery Claims case on the return's order | Reduction |
|---|---|
| Damaged in Transit Claim, Missing Item Claim or Wrong Item Claim, in status approved or resolved | 1.50 USD |
| Late Delivery Claim, in status approved or resolved | 1.00 USD |
| Any other order (no claim, a claim of another type, or a claim in another status) | None |

The reduction is taken off the return shipping fee after the fee is rounded to the cent, and the fee is never below zero.

## Points of judgement

| Claim on the order | Status | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Missing Item Claim | Resolved | 1.50 |
| Late Delivery Claim | Approved | 1.00 |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | Rejected | None |
| Delivered Not Received Claim | Resolved | None |

Example (hypothetical): a 6.95 fee on an order with an approved Wrong Item Claim becomes 5.45.
